$comment: The normative diagnostic code table (spec 1.0 §15.2, extended by 1.1 §11.2). The single source: the engine embeds it, the validator, conformance corpus and documentation all read it. Codes are stable API: a meaning never changes and a retired code is never reused.

codes.summary: missing or empty `medh5_version`, or the file or an object a check must read cannot be read
unsupported major version
identifier does not match its syntax: [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128} and not `meta`, or [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,255} for a collection's sample key
`meta` is absent or is not valid UTF-8 JSON
`meta` fails the sample-document JSON Schema
missing or unknown `medh5_kind`
missing `medh5_profiles`, or an unknown profile
a group required by the layout is absent (`grids`, `images`, a collection's `samples`), or a collection holds no sample root
declared profile's requirements are not met
sample root in a `collection` lacks its own `content_id`
a collection's `medh5_version` is lower than a member's
referenced grid does not exist
`direction` is not orthonormal to 1e-4
spatial axes are not contiguous and trailing
`spacing` is not strictly positive
multiscale level geometry is inconsistent with level 0
grid has no `timepoint` in a multi-timepoint sample
grid `timepoint` names an undeclared timepoint
`timepoints` is empty, an `id` repeats, or `index` is not dense/increasing
required grid attribute is missing or has the wrong rank
`axis_kinds` is invalid for the declared dimensionality
`grids` contains no grid
`images` contains no image
image shape does not equal its grid's `shape`
unknown `value_type`
`channel_names` length does not match the channel extent
required image attribute is missing
a declared profile requires a label set and none is present
duplicate class id or key in the label set
a reserved class id (0 or 65535) was assigned to a class
the class hierarchy contains a cycle
`form: ref` label set lacks `uri`/`sha256`, or is unresolvable
class entry is missing a required field, has an id out of range, or names an unknown parent
unknown annotation `kind`
class id is not present in the label set
`annotated_class_ids` is not a subset of `class_ids`
encoding invariant violated
dataset shape is inconsistent with the grid or with the annotation's other datasets, or mesh `faces` index outside its `vertices`
box `lo` exceeds `hi`
`rotations` is not a proper rotation matrix
offsets decrease, or contour or mesh offsets do not end at the number of vertices or faces they index
`timepoints` references an undeclared timepoint
a dataset required by the annotation `kind` is absent
dataset dtype is not permitted for the annotation `kind`, or a stored value is not one it permits (a `probmap` value outside [0, 1], a keypoint `visibility` other than 0, 1 or 2)
required annotation attribute is missing, or `task`, `closure`, `space` or `scope` holds an unknown value
a reference does not resolve, or an ignore or validity mask is not a `mask` on the same grid
`space` is invalid for the annotation's grid or frame
composite frame chain is broken
transform `kind` is missing or unknown, or a transform lacks the frames or parameters its kind requires, maps a frame to itself, or names an unknown `vector_space`
displacement field grid is not in `from_frame`
affine last row is not [0 … 0 1]
`inverse_id` is not mutually consistent
`units` missing, or not the units of the grids in its frames
`prov` names an activity that does not exist
`quality` names a record that does not exist
unknown agent or activity type
timestamp is not RFC 3339
activity names an agent that does not exist
object digest does not match its content
`content_id` does not match the file
malformed digest string
an object `content_id` covers is reached at a path that is not its own
`clinical/meta` is absent, not a scalar UTF-8 string, not JSON, or not canonical JSON
`clinical/meta` fails the clinical descriptor schema or its clock rules
clinical content is present but the `clinical` profile is not declared
a required clinical table or column is absent, or a member is not one the profile defines
a clinical column has the wrong dtype, rank or row count
a packed UTF-8 column's offsets are malformed or a cell is not valid UTF-8
a validity mask is malformed or misplaced, or a null cell holds a value
a valid floating-point clinical value is NaN or infinite
a clinical identifier is empty, malformed or not unique
an enumerated clinical value is outside its vocabulary
event time bounds are incomplete, inverted or inconsistent with `temporal_type`
event value, code, comparator, unit or missing-reason fields are inconsistent
a clinical reference does not resolve within the sample
a link's text span, instance annotation or imaging timepoint constraint is violated
a document is not owned by exactly one `document` event, or a `document` event owns more than one
a revision chain is broken, branching, cyclic or contradicted by availability
a lesion assessment lacks its timepoint, its instance link or a permitted value
a dataset under `clinical/` carries no `digest`
a clinical object carries an attribute the profile does not define
no object digests are present
bulk dataset is unchunked or uncompressed
no `deidentification` record
partial coverage without an ignore region
`index/` entry is stale for its source annotation
conflicting split claims for one `set_id`
float storage where int16 + rescale would be lossless
`layers` count is far from the greedy-colouring optimum
one `instance_id` carries two different class ids
grids in different timepoints share a `frame_uid`
multi-timepoint sample has no transform relating timepoints
class id used by an annotation has no ontology binding
a higher minor version: only the supported projection was validated, or an unsupported item was ignored
a numeric clinical value carries no unit
